title: Extensions feature completely removed in 2.3.4 — whole file documents a dead surface
reality: v2.3.4 removed the extension feature entirely: all extension CSS, browser, and server payload execution is gone; the Settings surface, client hooks, the shared marinara JS contract, and the /api/extensions routes were deleted; startup permanently erases every retained server record and extension-storage:* setting; the UI-state migration removes browser-local extension records; authoring guides, examples, and Professor Mari extension instructions were removed. Verified upstream: docs/extending/ now contains only custom-tools.md and regex-scripts.md; docs/EXTENSIONS.md 404s.
fix: Re-frame extensions.md as a removed-feature tombstone: open with a prominent 'REMOVED in v2.3.4' banner, state that everything below describes a feature that no longer exists in any form (no legacy/compat mode), delete or clearly historicize the marinara API reference, the CustomThemeInjector.tsx source-of-truth pointer, the zip import/export section, and the Writing an Extension examples; make the file's job answering 'where did extensions go?'.

title: No data-loss warning: upgrade permanently erases all extension records and storage
reality: Startup permanently erases every retained server extension record and every extension-storage:* app setting, and the UI-state migration removes browser-local extension records automatically. Data kept in marinara.storage (documented as durable, cross-device state) is destroyed on first 2.3.4 launch with no export path afterward.
fix: Add an explicit migration/data-loss section: upgrading to 2.3.4 irreversibly deletes all installed extensions and their server-backed storage; anything a user wants to keep must be copied out BEFORE upgrading; after upgrade there is nothing to recover.

title: Settings → Addons → Extensions install path gone; Addons now hosts only installed themes
reality: The extension Settings surface was deleted in 2.3.4, so the install instructions and hot-reload tip are dead paths. Settings > Addons survives for installed THEMES — a separate 2.3.4 fix applied the chroma text color to installed theme names there, confirming the themes surface remains.
fix: Replace the Installation and Distribution section and the hot-reload pitfall with a note that Settings > Addons now contains only installed themes.

title: 'Professor Mari can build extensions for you' is no longer true
reality: Professor Mari's extension instructions were removed with the feature in 2.3.4. Her themes/agents/custom-tools capabilities are unaffected.
fix: Update the Professor Mari paragraph: she can no longer create or edit extensions; keep themes, agents, and custom tools.

title: 'UI change → extension' routing table must be rewritten to surviving surfaces
reality: The 'When to Use Extensions vs. Other Surfaces' section routes users to a removed feature. Surviving v2.3.4 paths: native Appearance controls + server-synced custom themes (/api/themes) for styling; Regex Scripts for text transforms; custom tools/agents for capabilities; reviewed downloadable agent packages via the official catalog; and — new in 2.3.4 (#3861) — disabled-by-default custom GitHub agent repositories in Agents Manager as the sanctioned third-party distribution path.
fix: Rewrite the routing section: 'UI styling → Settings > Appearance / custom themes; text transforms → Regex Scripts; model capabilities → custom tools; per-turn behavior → agents; third-party distributable functionality → downloadable agent packages or custom GitHub agent repositories (#3861); anything else UI-structural → fork or upstream feature request.' Remove 'extension' as an answer.

title: Capability-package escape hatch should name custom GitHub agent repos (#3861)
reality: v2.3.4 added custom GitHub agent repositories to Agents Manager (#3861) — the new sanctioned way to distribute third-party packages outside the official catalog, disabled by default with explicit trust confirmation.
fix: In the tombstone's 'what replaced extensions' guidance, add custom GitHub agent repositories (#3861) alongside the official Download Agents catalog as the two legitimate distribution channels for third-party functionality.

title: Imported agents no longer bundle custom functions or self-grant tool access (#3953)
reality: v2.3.4 (#3953): agent exports no longer bundle custom function definitions; imported agent files cannot install bundled custom functions, grant themselves tool access, or overwrite a curated Agent by reusing its internal type; an imported agent receives a fresh custom identity and the user must review and explicitly attach tools afterward. custom-tools.md's attachment model says nothing about import/export, so users sharing agents will expect bundled tools to arrive working.
fix: Add a v2.3.4 note to the UI Location / attachment section: sharing an agent no longer carries its custom tools — export the tool definitions separately, and after importing an agent the recipient must re-create/attach tools explicitly (#3953).

title: Conditional prompt macros gained ||, &&, parentheses, equality-list shorthand
reality: v2.3.4 added || (OR), && (AND), parentheses grouping, and an equality-list shorthand to conditional prompt macros, with matching in-app and upstream documentation examples. No file in the skill's references documents conditional macros at all.
fix: Add a macros subsection (in custom-tools.md or cross-referenced from it) documenting conditional prompt macros and the new v2.3.4 boolean operators, parentheses, and equality-list shorthand with an example condition.

title: New {{group}} macro undocumented
reality: v2.3.4 added the {{group}} prompt macro listing every other active chat character, working during targeted Roleplay group generation; a companion fix keeps the full active roster available so {{group}} resolves the other character cards instead of empty in manual group generation.
fix: Document {{group}} in the same macros subsection.

title: Connection Custom Parameters paragraph stale vs #3845 (Noodle defaults, top-k/reasoning-effort/verbosity)
reality: custom-tools.md stops at v2.3/#3688. v2.3.4 (#3845) applies enabled Connection generation defaults across every Noodle text-generation path and lets custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints receive explicitly enabled top-k, reasoning-effort, and verbosity parameters.
fix: Extend the 'Connection Custom Parameters' paragraph with a v2.3.4 note (#3845).

title: Local ComfyUI video generation with placeholders and official workflow guide undocumented
reality: v2.3.4 added local ComfyUI video generation for API-format WAN and other workflows with prompt, size, seed, frame-count, and uploaded first-frame placeholders (#3804), plus an in-app and GitHub ComfyUI workflow guide (#3749).
fix: Add a provider note (architecture.md's provider coverage) for local ComfyUI video generation via API-format workflows with Marinara placeholders (#3804) and point to the official ComfyUI workflow guide (#3749).

title: TTS dialogue pause now whole seconds 1-60; legacy sub-second values migrated
reality: v2.3.4 changed the TTS dialogue pause control to whole seconds from 1 through 60, migrating legacy sub-second and no-pause values to the new 1-second minimum (supersedes the 2.3.3 behavior, #3718). No pause note exists in these two files today; the 2.3.3-era note lives elsewhere in the skill.
fix: Where the skill documents TTS settings, state pauses are whole seconds 1-60 with a 1s minimum and that pre-2.3.4 sub-second/zero values are auto-migrated.

title: PocketTTS server voices now directly selectable (#3786)
reality: v2.3.4 made PocketTTS server voices directly selectable for global, character, and narrator assignments while retaining custom voice IDs, URLs, and paths, and aligned new PocketTTS setups with the compatible server's default endpoint (#3786).

title: NovelAI prompt review shows subject-count-resolved dimensions (#3758)
reality: v2.3.4 made image prompt review display the subject-count-resolved dimensions actually sent to native NovelAI, kept Prompt Prefix count tokens out of scene sizing, and filled new NovelAI settings for legacy partial profiles (#3758).
fix: Where the skill covers NovelAI subject-count framing, add the #3758 refinements.
